findings.identity_explanation: COM-04 line 11 uses tag FCU-507, which is not a simple format variant of one tag: '507' could mean FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08. Model CF-12 agrees with CR:FCU-L5-08 but is identical for FCU-L5-07 too, so it does not discriminate. Location 'Level 5 east wing' agrees with CR:FCU-L5-08 (FCU-L5-07 is west wing), but the tag suggests unit 07 while the location suggests 08, so the attributes point to more than one asset. Serial is 'Not recorded'. COR-02 says the contractor does not yet know which unit was tested. Matching 3.1 applies, so the records are not merged.

exceptions.finding: COM-04 tag FCU-507 cannot be matched with confidence to FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08 (tag points to 07, location to east wing = 08, serial not recorded). The contractor itself has not confirmed which unit was tested.

findings.summary: FCU-L5-08 has an FM record, warranty (expires 2028-10-31), O&M coverage and a PPM plan, but no commissioning certificate with its exact tag. COM-04 is tagged FCU-507, and the tag, location and missing serial do not point to one unit; the contractor has not yet confirmed which. The match is uncertain, so I have not merged records and recommend Conflicting information, with escalation to the FM handover manager.
findings.escalation_reason: Asset match is uncertain (Escalation 2.2, Matching 3.1): COM-04 tag FCU-507 could be FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08. The handover manager must decide whether to approve an on-site verification request to the contractor; handover is planned for 24 November 2026.
findings.clarification_subject: Sarava Tower: verify unit tested on COM-04 (tag FCU-507), Level 5 fan coil units
findings.clarification_body: Commissioning certificate COM-04 (Brisel MEP Services, test date 2026-10-28) lists asset FCU-507, model CF-12, serial not recorded, location Level 5 east wing. Our registers have FCU-L5-07 (Level 5 west wing) and FCU-L5-08 (Level 5 east wing). The tag and location do not point clearly to one unit, and COR-02 says the unit is still to be checked. Please have the installer verify on site which unit was tested, record its serial number from the unit, and reissue the certificate with the exact register tag and a signed final approval. We also need confirmation that FCU-L5-08 has its own signed commissioning certificate. Please reply before the planned handover on 24 November 2026.
uncertainties: Which unit COM-04 relates to (FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08) is unknown.
Serial of the unit tested is not recorded in COM-04.
Whether FCU-L5-08 has been commissioned at all is unknown.
COM-12 for FCU-L5-07 shows Final approval not signed; it is a different asset and was not used as evidence here.
